dos_transformations.before: /* Game pad: SELECT cycles the hotbar */

transformations.before: int memcmp(const void *a,const void *b,unsigned int n)
int memcmp(const void *a,const void *b,unsigned int n);

dos_transformations.before:
/* Pixel pairs; an odd count enters at the second pixel of a pair */
	movl	rowW,%eax
	incl	%eax
	shrl	$1,%eax
	decl	%eax
	shll	$16,%eax		/* Pair counter in the upper half of EAX */
	testb	$1,rowW
	jz	20f
	subl	$\SCALE,%edi
	jmp	21f

20:	/* ---- per pixel pair ---- */
	TEXEL	\SCALE,\TRANSP,\WRAP,0
21:
	TEXEL	\SCALE,\TRANSP,\WRAP,\SCALE
	addl	$2*\SCALE,%edi
	subl	$0x10000,%eax
	jnc	20b
dos_transformations.after:
.if !\TRANSP
	/* Four opaque texels per iteration. The first partial group enters
	   at its first required store; no extra texture reads/writes. */
	movl	rowW,%eax
	addl	$3,%eax
	shrl	$2,%eax
	decl	%eax
	shll	$16,%eax
	testb	$3,rowW
	jz	20f
	testb	$2,rowW
	jnz	17f
	subl	$3*\SCALE,%edi
	jmp	23f
17:
	testb	$1,rowW
	jnz	18f
	subl	$2*\SCALE,%edi
	jmp	22f
18:
	subl	$\SCALE,%edi
	jmp	21f
20:
	TEXEL	\SCALE,\TRANSP,\WRAP,0
21:
	TEXEL	\SCALE,\TRANSP,\WRAP,\SCALE
22:
	TEXEL	\SCALE,\TRANSP,\WRAP,2*\SCALE
23:
	TEXEL	\SCALE,\TRANSP,\WRAP,3*\SCALE
	addl	$4*\SCALE,%edi
	subl	$0x10000,%eax
	jnc	20b
	.else
	/* Pixel pairs; an odd count enters at the second pixel of a pair */
	movl	rowW,%eax
	incl	%eax
	shrl	$1,%eax
	decl	%eax
	shll	$16,%eax		/* Pair counter in the upper half of EAX */
	testb	$1,rowW
	jz	20f
	subl	$\SCALE,%edi
	jmp	21f

20:	/* ---- per pixel pair ---- */
	TEXEL	\SCALE,\TRANSP,\WRAP,0
21:
	TEXEL	\SCALE,\TRANSP,\WRAP,\SCALE
	addl	$2*\SCALE,%edi
	subl	$0x10000,%eax
	jnc	20b
	.endif
